# AI

> Caligrafy Quill 2.25.0. Generated from the source by `php qa/build-api-reference.php`; the guides explain how to use these classes, this reference says exactly what each public method takes and returns. Back to the [API reference](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/API-Reference).

OpenAI, open models through OpenAI-compatible providers, the OpenAI Assistants and Watson.

| Class | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`Caligrafy\OpenAI`](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/API-AI#openai) | The Watson class handles all exchanges with the OpenAI models |
| [`Caligrafy\Agent`](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/API-AI#agent) | The Agent class talks to open models through OpenAI-compatible providers: Groq (default, through groq-php), Together AI, Fireworks AI, OpenRouter, a local Ollama or any custom endpoint. |
| [`Caligrafy\Assistant`](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/API-AI#assistant) | The Assistant class runs conversations with OpenAI models through the Responses and Conversations APIs. |
| [`Caligrafy\Watson`](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/wiki/API-AI#watson) | The Watson class handles all exchanges with the Watson Assistant |

<a name="agent"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Agent

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Agent extends \stdClass
```

Source: [framework/core/Agent.php:37](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Agent.php#L37)

The Agent class talks to open models through OpenAI-compatible providers:
Groq (default, through groq-php), Together AI, Fireworks AI, OpenRouter, a local Ollama or any custom endpoint.

Choose the provider in .env with AGENT_PROVIDER (groq|together|fireworks|openrouter|ollama|custom).
Key: the provider key (GROQ_API_KEY, TOGETHER_API_KEY, FIREWORKS_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY) or AGENT_API_KEY.
AGENT_API_BASE overrides the endpoint (required for custom), AGENT_MODEL and AGENT_VISION_MODEL the default models.
The GROQ_* settings and constants keep working as before.

Groq keeps groq-php: its audio endpoints (multipart uploads) and behavior stay unchanged. The other providers
only need chat completions and the model list, sent with cURL (no extra dependency).

### Constants

+ `PROVIDERS = ...`: Providers: label, default endpoint, key setting, default models (October 2026), audio support, where to get a key and where the models are listed. Ollama needs no key; custom needs AGENT_API_BASE and AGENT_MODEL. Serverless Llama (October 2026): OpenRouter and Ollama only. Groq retired its Llama chat models in August 2026, Together and Fireworks only serve Llama on dedicated/on-demand deployments: their defaults are gpt-oss-120b. Preview models: Groq qwen/qwen3.8-27b.
+ `TIMEOUT = 120`

<a name="assistant"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Assistant

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Assistant extends \stdClass
```

Source: [framework/core/Assistant.php:41](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Assistant.php#L41)

The Assistant class runs conversations with OpenAI models through the Responses and Conversations APIs.

OpenAI shut down the Assistants API on August 26, 2026. Version 2.0 of this class keeps the same chainable
methods (start, createMessage, run, retrieveResponse, end) on top of the APIs that replace it:

- the assistant (model, instructions, tools) is configuration kept in this object and sent with every response
- a conversation (POST /v1/conversations) replaces the thread
- a response (POST /v1/responses) replaces the run
- files are searched through a vector store (file_search tool)

### Public properties

+ `public $name`: string the name of the assistant (used for the vector store name and metadata)
+ `public $description`: string what the assistant does (local description)
+ `public $instructions`: string the instructions (system prompt) sent with every response
+ `public $tools = array(["type" => "file_search"])`: array the tools: ["type" =&gt; "file_search"] is completed with the vector store, ["type" =&gt; "code_interpreter"] gets an automatic container with the uploaded files
+ `public $file_ids =[]`: array ids of the files uploaded for the assistant
+ `public $file_paths =[]`: array local paths of the files to upload
+ `public $metadata`: array metadata sent with every response (up to 16 string pairs)
+ `public $vector_store_id = ''`: string the vector store that holds the files searched by file_search
+ `public $assistant_id = ''`: string kept for backward compatibility: the Assistants API no longer exists, nothing is created on OpenAI
+ `public $thread_id = ''`: string the active conversation id (conv_...). Kept under its old name for backward compatibility
+ `public $run_id = ''`: string the last response id (resp_...)
+ `public $status = 'queued'`: string the status of the last response: completed, failed, in_progress, queued, incomplete, cancelled
+ `public $messages =[]`: array the messages of the conversation: the user messages added and the assistant messages received. Every message is ['id', 'role', 'content' =&gt; [['type' =&gt; 'input_text'|'output_text', 'text' =&gt; '...']]]
+ `public $response_text = ''`: string the text of the last assistant answer
+ `public $last_response =[]`: array the last raw response returned by OpenAI (useful for errors and usage)
